note: BEFORE is commit 647aa76 reference/ measured unmodified; AFTER is this commit. Both measured in the same real headless Chromium with the same harness.

rootCauses.defect: .live declared height:100dvh then height:100vh, so 100vh won and defeated dvh
rootCauses.fix: .live-host declares the 100vh FALLBACK FIRST, then 100dvh; .live is height:100%

rootCauses.defect: the rig .app used only min-height:100%, breaking the percentage height chain so viewport units measured the outer browser
.lctrl permitted flex-wrap:wrap so the persistent dock could become multiple rows
rootCauses.fix: .lctrl{flex:0 0 auto;flex-wrap:nowrap}; the only remaining wrap is the documented WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 reflow exception below 361px

rootCauses.defect: session-details and sheet-close carried inline 40x40 minimums
rootCauses.fix: no inline minimums remain; .live button,.live [role=button]{min-width:44px;min-height:44px} is the floor

rootCauses.defect: self-view move/minimise were 30x30 and the landscape self-view was 78x58, too small for two 44x44 controls
rootCauses.fix: controls moved inside the self-view; portrait 112x140 and landscape 116x100 contain two 44x44 targets without overlap; minimised hides .selfmove, the tile >svg and .nm2, leaving exactly one 44x44 restore control

rootCauses.defect: the live container did not establish the explicit positioned constrained three-row layout
